question: Where can I find museum inside 30 kilometers while progressing from Super Cichlids Inc, Dover, DE toward Alley Cat, Baltimore, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Super Cichlids Inc%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dover%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%DE%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Alley Cat%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 30000 ) );
